notes: Medium (total 10). Byte-cap fragmentation with checksum-verified reassembly: pack must fragment any input into frame_%05d.bin files each <= CAP (non-multiple tails, exact multiples, caps larger than the input, empty input producing zero frames) and record an invertible manifest (index.json with per-frame offset/length/sha256 plus whole-input sha256); unpack must verify every frame digest and the assembled digest, reproduce the original bytes exactly, and refuse (non-zero exit, no output file, 'corrupt' on stderr) on any tampered frame. dependent_stages=2 (pack then join), quantitative_correctness=2 (exact bytes and digests), adversarial_inputs=2 (invalid cap, missing input, corrupted frame), hidden_case_generalization=2 (verifier re-runs pack/unpack on seven hidden configurations). Distinct from the sibling splitter task: frame naming width, manifest schema with sha256 verification, and corrupt-frame refusal semantics.
